newsitem.title: USA: CytRx Phase I Optivax trial positive.
newsitem.headline: CytRx Phase I Optivax trial positive.

text.p: Vaxcel Inc, a subsidiary of CytRx Corp, said on Wednesday that a Phase I clinical trial has demonstrated its Optivax vaccine adjuvant to be well tolerated and effective for cancer.
An adjuvant is a compound that makes vaccines more effective.
In this Phase I trial, Optivax was administered in combination with a fixed dose of a vaccine in patients with metastatic cancer.
Optivax is Vaxcel's proprietary vaccine delivery and adjuvant system that is based on a synthetic copolymer molecular structure.
In December 1996, it was announced that Vaxcel would merge with Zynaxis Inc.
